set.title: Magic: The Gathering® | Avatar: The Last Airbender™
set.copy: Bend the battlefield with Magic cards from Avatar: The Last Airbender! Master the elements and join your favorite characters for new adventures, iconic art, an elemental showdown like never before.

products.name: Play Boosters
products.markdownCopy: Join the fray with powerful bending masters, hybrid animals, and lovable allies wielding blades, boomerangs, and the occasional cabbage!

products.name: Collector Boosters
products.markdownCopy: Explore the world of Avatar: The Last Airbender! Capture the quenchiest cards of unforgettable allies, hybrid animals, and fearsome foes across the four nations.

products.name: Jumpstart Boosters
products.markdownCopy: Hybrid animals are twice the fun, and with Jumpstart you mash two packs together to make a deck. You're ready to play right out of the packs, so yip yip!

products.name: Commander's Bundle
products.markdownCopy: This masterful bundle unites the core elements of the set and adds Commander staples to build the deck the world needs most.

products.name: Prerelease Packs
products.markdownCopy: Choose your element. Master your deck. Join a Prerelease near you and start your journey to bring balance to the game.

products.name: Scene Boxes
products.markdownCopy: Bring balance to your collection with Scenes recreating iconic moments in multiple cards. Unite the cards, complete the Scene. Save the world.

products.name: Beginner Box
products.markdownCopy: Play your first *Magic* game in a guided battle of Aang vs Zuko to learn essential gameplay, then choose a side and balance or conquer the four nations of *Avatar: The Last Airbender*!
